# Project Plan: User-Facing Search Feature Rollout

---

## Step 1 — Scope

### Goals
- Ship a search feature that lets users find content (e.g., products, articles, records) by keyword from any page in the app.
- Return relevant, ranked results within acceptable latency (<500ms p95).
- Instrument search for analytics (query volume, zero-result rate, click-through).

### Constraints
- Must integrate with the existing backend data store (no new data platform approved).
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance required.
- Target: production-ready within **6 weeks** from kick-off.
- Team: 2 frontend engineers, 1 backend engineer, 1 QA engineer, 1 designer.

### Out of Scope
- AI/semantic search or embeddings (keyword/full-text only in v1).
- Search within file attachments or binary content.
- Real-time indexing (near-real-time, ≤5 min lag, is acceptable).
- Multi-language/locale support beyond English.
- Saved searches or search history persistence.

---

## Step 2 — Milestones & Work Breakdown

Dependencies are noted as `[depends on: TASK-ID]`. The **critical path** is marked ⚡.

```

```

Compressing any task on this path delays ship date.

---

## Step 3 — Definition of Done

The feature is **done** when **all** of the following are observable and verified:

### Functional
- [ ] A search bar is present and keyboard-focusable on every page in the app.
- [ ] Entering a keyword returns ranked results within 500ms p95 (measured in load test report — artifact: `perf-test-report.md`).
- [ ] Empty-state and error-state UI render correctly for zero results and API failure (verified by QA test run).
- [ ] Search index covers 100% of in-scope entities, verified by running a spot-check query for 10 known records and confirming all appear.

### Quality
- [ ] All E2E tests in the Cypress/Playwright suite pass with 0 failures in CI (artifact: CI run link).
- [ ] Zero open P0/P1 bugs in Jira tagged `search-feature`.
- [ ] Accessibility audit report shows 0 critical violations; keyboard navigation and screen reader test passed (artifact: `a11y-audit-report.pdf`).
- [ ] Security review signed off — input sanitization confirmed, rate limiting active (artifact: signed security review ticket).

### Operational
- [ ] Feature is behind a feature flag and was dark-launched to internal users for ≥24 hours without incidents.
- [ ] Runbook exists and has been reviewed by at least one other engineer (artifact: Confluence page URL).
- [ ] Analytics dashboard shows search events firing in production (query, result-click, zero-result events all present in data warehouse).
- [ ] Rollout reached 100% of users with no spike in error rate or latency beyond baseline (observable in monitoring dashboard).

---

## Step 4 — Top Risks & Mitigations

| # | Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|------|-------------|--------|------------|
| R-1 | **Index performance degrades at scale** — full-text queries on large tables are slow | Medium | High | Run load test (T-15) early; add query timeout + result-count cap; consider a dedicated search service if p95 >500ms in test |
| R-2 | **Incremental sync misses updates** — new/edited records don't appear in results | Medium | High | Test sync lag end-to-end (T-07 + T-14); add a reconciliation job that compares index vs DB row count daily; alert on lag >10 min |
| R-3 | **Scope creep from stakeholders** ("can we add filters?") delays launch | High | Medium | Lock scope in this document before M1; any additions go to a v1.1 backlog; PM owns the gate |
| R-4 | **Accessibility failures discovered late** — WCAG issues are expensive to fix post-build | Low | High | Embed accessibility checks in component build (T-12) not just in audit (T-16); use axe-core in CI from day one |
| R-5 | **Search results are low quality** — users can't find what they expect | Medium | High | Define relevance test cases during T-01 (10 "golden queries" with expected top result); validate in QA; collect zero-result rate post-launch and iterate |
| R-6 | **Feature flag infrastructure doesn't exist** — rollout blocked at M5 | Low | High | Confirm flag tooling in Week 1; if absent, build a simple env-var toggle as fallback (T-19 contingency) |
